ideas.pitch: A localized Poisson regression and GAM forecasting model predicting cliffside erosion and sea-level impact along La Jolla shores using historical geological data.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact winning pattern of high-complexity predictive modeling seen in ai-incident-forecasting, leveraging hard statistics that appeal to technical judges in coastal research hubs.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the multi-agent architecture of the GreenNovation win, targeting judges looking for practical ecological applications built with advanced agentic workflows.
